decisions.reason: As a newly launched but more niche workstation, it is still an option worth keeping open because uncertainty remains high, the firm has the scale and technical base to support it, and there is no clear negative signal yet.

This printer fits the firm’s core coding portfolio and single-source application strategy, so in a growing market a large R&D-active firm would usually keep it on the market while demand information accumulates.

Although somewhat more specialized and potentially costlier to support than thermal inkjet, it broadens the technology set offered to different surfaces and applications, which makes it valuable to retain as an option for now.
